Game Icon:maricaripan
Thumbnail,Loading screen:JUST4GLITCH
Welcome to the place where forgotten things are thrown away.
Lost people, failed experiments, broken worlds… everything ends up here.

SURVIVORS: Complete the objectives, protect each other, and survive until the timer hits 0.  
KILLERS: Hunt them down. Don’t let anyone escape.

Every quest you finish wakes something deeper.  
Every match strengthens the world watching you.

Once you enter, there is no going back.
This is your home now abandoned, corrupted, and never letting go.
